title: Uandishi Bora (Theme 1: Darasani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: Before writing the child checks posture and grip, then starts at the left of the line and moves right.

floor.prerequisite: Draws a line and a circle with a crayon.
floor.question: Chora mstari kutoka kushoto kwenda kulia.
floor.answer: the child draws a straight line

representations: pictures of good and poor writing positions
a pencil grip marked with a band
a green start line on each line
steps: Hold the pencil with three fingers.
Start at the green line and go right.
contexts: writing at home at the table
copying a pattern from the board

board.do: Point at the green start line.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes a row of a from left to right with the right grip.

misconceptions.repair: Shika kalamu kwa vidole vitatu, si kwa ngumi.
Keti wima na unyooshe daftari kabla ya kuandika.

misconceptions.ask: Mstari wa kijani uko upande gani?

listen_for: kwa nguvu sana mpaka karatasi ikatike
misconceptions.ask: Ukurasa unaofuata una alama za kalamu yako?
